spans.s: लेट् a general term for the affixes of the Vedic subjunctive, the usual personal-endings ति, तस् etc. being substituted for लेट् as in the case of other tenses and moods. The augments अट् and आट् are some- times prefixed to the लेट् affix and the sign ( विकरण ) स् ( सिप् ) is some- times added to the roots. The forms of लेट् are to be arrived at as they are found actually used in Vedic language, even by placing personal-endings of a person or number different from what is actually required.
